title: Strong Zero Modes via Commutant Algebras
summary: Strong Zero Modes (SZMs) are (approximately) conserved quantities that result in (approximate) double degeneracies in the entire spectra of certain Hamiltonians, with the Majorana zero mode of the transverse-field Ising chain being a primary example. In this work, we discover via a systematic search that many examples of SZMs can be understood as symmetries in the commutant algebra framework, which reveals novel algebraic structures hidden in Hamiltonians with well-known SZMs, including the transverse-field Ising chain.
